grammarRule.formula: Can I try this on? / Do you have this in a medium / large size?

explanation.ml: തുണിക്കടകളിൽ വസ്ത്രങ്ങൾ നോക്കുമ്പോൾ 'Can I try this on?' (എനിക്കിതൊന്ന് ഇട്ടുനോക്കാമോ?), 'Where is the trial room?' (ട്രയൽ റൂം എവിടെയാണ്?), 'Do you have a smaller size?' (ഇതിന്റെ ചെറിയ അളവ് ഉണ്ടോ?) തുടങ്ങിയ സ്വാഭാവിക ശൈലികൾ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Shopping for Clothes & Trial Room with clear formula: Can I try this on? / Do you have this in a medium / large size?

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 അളവുകൾ ചോദിക്കുമ്പോൾ: Small (എസ്), Medium (എം), Large (എൽ), Extra Large (എക്സ് എൽ). പാകമാണോ എന്നറിയാൻ: 'Does it fit well?' (നന്നായി ചേരുന്നുണ്ടോ?).
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 അളവുകൾ ചോദിക്കുമ്പോൾ: Small (എസ്), Medium (എം), Large (എൽ), Extra Large (എക്സ് എൽ). പാകമാണോ എന്നറിയാൻ: 'Does it fit well?' (നന്നായി ചേരുന്നുണ്ടോ?).

nouns.example: This cotton garment is handcrafted by local traditional weavers.

nouns.definition: The action of trying on clothes to see if they fit properly.
nouns.example: The shoulders and sleeve length have a perfect tailored fitting.

nouns.definition: Cloth produced through weaving, knitting, or felting fibers.
nouns.example: Pure linen fabric feels breathable and cool during hot summer days.
He prefers comfortable casual shirts for weekend gatherings.

nouns.definition: A change or modification made to clothing for a better fit.
nouns.example: Does the clothing store provide free alteration for trousers?

nouns.definition: Characteristic of, influenced by, or representing a current popular style.
nouns.example: These embroidered denim jackets are very fashionable among youngsters.

traps.question: Select the natural phrase to ask permission to wear a dress in the trial room:
options: Can I wear this to test?
Can I put this on body now?
traps.explanation: 'Can I try this on?' is the standard native idiom for trying on clothes in a shop.
traps.ruleHint: Phrasal Verb: 'try on' = put clothes on to see if they fit.

traps.question: How do you ask for a bigger size politely?
options: Do you have this in a larger size?
Is larger size available by you?
traps.explanation: 'Do you have this in a larger size?' is polite and natural.
traps.ruleHint: Shopping English: 'Do you have this in a [smaller/larger] size?'

traps.question: Choose the correct preposition: 'The trial room is ______ your right.'
traps.explanation: Directions use the preposition 'on': 'on your right / on your left'.
traps.ruleHint: Direction Rule: on your right / on your left.
